#Welcome to the CrysPyML Page!

= Introduction =

The goal of this subproject is to wrap the CrysFML libraries at the ILL using python.  We'd love to have more contributors.  Currently, we are considering:

Babel (Did you know gfortran can export the input files for that package)?
A GSOC project based on f2py
ctypes
subprocessing or pexepect in the worst case


= Details =

Please let us know what you suggest!!!
